newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND STARS CAN CASH IN WITH ONE-YEAR DEAL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND STARS CAN CASH IN WITH ONE-YEAR DEAL.

text.p: Will Carling and other senior England players can earn 70,000 pounds ($112,000) from new contracts.
One-year deals are on offer from the Rugby Football Union (RFU) to cover match fees and win bonuses for seven tests, starting against Italy on November 23.

RFU secretary Tony Hallett, mindful of the on-going dispute between the union and the players' clubs over control of the game at top level, said: "No deadline has been set for players to sign these contracts and there is no compulsion for someone to sign in order to play.
"The players are currently scanning the contracts and I would expect them to go back to their clubs with them.
"A top international can expect to earn between 60,000 and 70,000 pounds if he plays in all this season's internationals."
